title: $8.2 Billion From a Card, Not a Seat
description:
How did Delta get 8.2 billion dollars from a credit card?

Sources:
- Delta 2025 results: Amex remuneration $8.2B (AltexSoft): https://www.altexsoft.com/travel-industry-news/premium-strategy-works-deltas-2025-revenue-hits-63b/
- Delta cards ~13% of Amex billed business (View from the Wing): https://viewfromthewing.com/amex-pays-delta-3-8-cents-per-dollar-charged-why-banks-pay-more-for-miles-than-you-do/

Figures are from company filings and reporting cited above. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: How did Delta get 8.2 billion dollars from a credit card?
Not from tickets. It came from American Express, in 2025.

visual.label: paid to Delta by American Express, 2025

scenes.narration: Every swipe of a Delta Amex card earns SkyMiles. Amex buys those miles from Delta.
Groceries, gas, anything. Delta cards are about 13 percent of all Amex spending worldwide.

visual.label: of Amex's worldwide spending is on Delta cards

scenes.narration: And miles don't need fuel, pilots, or planes. That's what makes them such good business.
